title: Nepal–Sikh war
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Nepal–Sikh war", at revision 1380249172, opens: "The Nepal–Sikh war was a small conflict in 1809 between the forces of the Kingdom of Nepal under Amar Singh Thapa and the Sikh Empire under Maharaja Ranjit Singh." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q27963620, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "small conflict between the forces of Maharaja Ranjit Singh (Sikh Empire) and the Gurkha Army in 1809". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
